instrumentation_flag_meaning: The unchanged raw runtime_optimization_applied and optimization_applied fields are false because the instrumenter does not patch runtime. This source revision implements the bounded fresh schema remapping shortcut.

runtime_compatibility.excluded_first_pipeline_receipt: 172 passes and six missing-PATH Forge skips; excluded in full and replaced by a complete same-178-ID zero-skip receipt using the verified installed external toolchain.

inference: All four fixed shapes completed with the same baseline file counts, total file bytes, synthetic costs, request allowance, finding counts and integrity-check call counts. Each execution preserved its own original file bytes, identity and permissions.

The three larger cases have lower median phase times than the recorded baseline. For depth four, observed median export decreased from 18.619274709 to 11.016918208 seconds and original resume from 44.376880167 to 25.979807666 seconds.

Depth one is mixed: evidence, artifact, export and resume wall medians increased, while resumed export decreased. Its construction measured 11.368116459 seconds wall versus 5.442033 seconds CPU; the off-CPU contribution does not identify a cause.
The earlier baseline also varies, including depth-three initial versus resumed export. These observations do not isolate a causal speedup or establish production throughput.
Fresh integrity checks remain in every existing call position; there is no cross-call schema or authority cache, skipped guard or qualification, lineage, seal or release relaxation.
limitations: One nonisolated local host, not an interleaved randomized before/after experiment or independent repetitions.
Three unprofiled samples and one separate profile per phase per fixed synthetic case; construction is separately timed.
Typed provisional inventory export, not complete client Markdown rendering or whole-audit latency.
Python 3.13.15 and the recorded installed dependencies only; no Python 3.12 runtime or dependency-version matrix result.
The shortcut uses private Pydantic interfaces and requires renewed compatibility validation when dependencies change.
Synthetic journal costs are invariants, not provider bills or observations of private operator ledgers.
No provider execution, qualified audit, best-in-class claim, adoption, sealing, release or deployment evidence.
